Claim 1 (Currently Amended): 2) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-indole-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): 3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): 4) Composition according to one or more of Claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): 6) Composition according to Claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5 ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): 9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): 10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): 11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as a skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): 13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): 14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
